title: feat(studio): the main area adapts when the Studio right slot opens
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-warren"} -->
_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8EYLLcfPhnAg83bCHa7wckF)_
Fixes #35061
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：Studio 右栏打开时主区域自适应——左侧对象 / 流程 / 导航 / 权限集列表在内容区不足 900 时收成 52 宽窄栏（每项一个字、悬停显示全名、顶部「»」浮层展开）；权限矩阵窗格不足 1000 时只平铺新建 / 查看 / 编辑 / 删除，其余 6 项收进每行「更多权限」（已开 N 项），批量按钮收成「批量」菜单；记录表横向滚动条常显，选中的列自动滚进可见区；右栏可在 320–560 间拖宽，「属性」「AI 助手」各记宽度（默认 360 / 420）。
- 为什么改：右栏打开时主区域被挤到不能用（#35061，方向「挤压但让主区域自适应、不用浮层」已获「同意」）。
- 风险与回滚：只动 Studio 界面与浏览器本地偏好，不碰元数据与接口；收窄全靠 CSS 容器查询，右栏关闭或窗口够宽即恢复原样；旧的共用右栏宽度作废，每栏回到默认一次；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`StudioRail.tsx` 与 `studio-tokens.ts`（窄栏与浮层，四个栏共用）、`PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`（矩阵折叠）、`studioRightSlotState.ts`（每栏宽度与 320–560 夹取）。
- 两分钟验证：1280×800 打开 Studio 并打开 AI 助手：左侧列表成窄栏，点「»」浮出完整列表、Esc 收回；权限页一屏内可勾两个对象的增删改查、「更多权限」点开可改；关掉右栏，列表与 10 列矩阵恢复。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

One draft PR for the four items of #35061, on one branch. Items 4 and 1 are this dev's; items 2 and 3 came from a second dev and were merged in with a real merge commit (`0be07d82`).

| Item | What | Commit(s) | Tests |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 · left rails narrow | the four rails draw 52 px while the slot squeezes the content under 900 px; 「»」 floats the full rail | `007014ce`, `50fedf06`, `6eaa56dc`, `f422b0d4` | `StudioRail.noMatches-26733.test.tsx` → describe `the rails' narrow form (objectstack#35061)`; `StudioDesignSurface.rightSlot-12725.test.tsx` → describe `…the rails read whether it squeezes the pillars (objectstack#35061)` |
| 2 · permission matrix | under a 1000 px matrix pane: four CRUD columns flat, six behind 「更多权限」, one 「批量」 menu | `b90c8c6e`, `c65c7a66`, `3712d751` | `PermissionMatrixEditor.fold-35061.test.tsx` (6 tests) |
| 3 · records table | scrollbar at rest; a selected field's column scrolls into view | `279f7c4c`, `7d6da261` | `DataPillar.recordsScroll-35061.test.tsx` (8 tests) |
| 4 · right slot resizable | 320–560 range; properties and copilot each remember their own width (defaults 360 / 420) | `22185a4f`, `1be92568`, `18f0da4f` | `studioRightSlot-12725.test.tsx` → describe `StudioRightSlot pane widths (objectstack#35061)` |

**Item 1** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/`): while the right slot shows beside the pillars and the content column next to the 240 px rail would be under 900 px, every Studio rail (Data, Automations, Interfaces, Access) draws 52 px wide. Each row shows one character of its name (`railAbbreviation`, a whole grapheme, upper-cased in the display locale) as generated content, so the row's text and accessible name are unchanged; the full name is the row's hover. Groups show as a rule; anything that is not a row or a group (empty notes, the nav editor) leaves the narrow list. A 「»」 bar floats the full rail over the content column until a row is picked, Escape (focus back on 「»」) or a click outside. The rule is the `dataTabsFold.ts` way: a CSS container query on the pillars' host (`STUDIO_PILLARS_HOST`, 1140 px = 900 px of content + the 240 px rail), plus the host's `data-studio-slot` marker, which the surface sets only while the slot squeezes the pillars (not under `md`). No JS width read, nothing reads an edit mode, and the rail keeps `STUDIO_RAIL_WIDTH` in every pillar and mode (objectui#12519). Phones keep the rail's own overlay.

**Item 2** (`views/metadata-admin/PermissionMatrixEditor.tsx`, `permissionMatrixFold.ts`): below a 1000 px matrix pane each Access-pillar object row keeps Create / Read / Edit / Delete flat; the other six (Export, Transfer, View all, Modify all, read and write scope) move behind the row's 「更多权限」 button, which shows 「已开 N 项」 and opens them in a row beneath; the All · Read only · None · Read & write strip becomes one 「批量」 menu. At 1000 px and wider the matrix is the full flat grid. Setup's permission page is a different table and does not fold.

**Item 3** (`views/studio-design/recordsGridChrome.ts`, the Data pillar's Records tab): the grid's horizontal scrollbar shows at rest, and a field selected by its column header or from the field list scrolls its column into view, clear of the frozen name column. Column widths, the frozen column and the 400 px long-text ceiling are the runtime grid's, unchanged.

**Item 4**: `clampStudioSlotWidth` keeps the slot within 320–560 px and, as before, never so wide that the canvas drops under `DOCK_CONTENT_MIN_WIDTH` (520); the console drawer's `clampDockWidth` is untouched. `useStudioSlotWidth(mode)` keeps one width per pane under `studio-right-slot-width-props` / `studio-right-slot-width-copilot`. The width both panes used to share (`studio-right-slot-width`) is removed on first read, not migrated: carrying it into either pane would override the default the card names for it. The copilot's in-place widen keeps its own width outside the range, and the phone overlay keeps its own fixed width with no handle (card: 「不改手机端」).

## Tests

New pins go into each component's existing harness file as a new top-level describe where one exists (the repository rule for a component with a shared harness), and into new files named for #35061 where none does. Existing pins my change made false were updated in place: the slot's old width pin moved to a 1000 px viewport (a 643 px slot is now outside the range), and the Objects rail's row collector in `DataPillar.draftObjectLabel-11843.test.tsx` skips the new 「»」 control.

## Acceptance notes

- objectui#12519 read as left-rail only; per-pane widths per #35061 item 4 (maintainer 「同意」 2026-11-17)
- Item 1 reading of the fourth acceptance line: with the slot at 420 px a 1440 px window leaves the pillars 1020 px, so a 240 px rail would leave the content 780 px, under the card's 900 px; the rail narrows there. 「内容区够宽的」 is read as the condition: the rail stays 240 px from a 1560 px window with the copilot (1500 px with the 360 px properties pane), and at any width with the slot closed.
- Item 1: the pillars' host is now a size container, so an unnamed container query inside a pillar with no nearer container answers the host's width (before, it matched nothing). The Studio's own unnamed queries all sit under a nearer container (the item header row, the Data content column, the form designer sections, the matrix pane).
- Item 1: the narrow rows' character is generated content with an empty alternative, so a screen reader keeps the row's own name (checked in Chromium: the narrow rail's accessibility tree names each row by its full label).
- Clause-② measured no: the `studio` namespace's built declarations type each catalogue as `Record<string, string>`, so no key is published in a type.

## Verification

<details><summary>Merged head 0be07d82: type-check, tests, gates</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/i18n run type-check && pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- The four items' 35061 files, the slot and rail harnesses, `PermissionMatrixEditor.*`, `StudioDesignSurface.access*`: Test Files 62 passed (62), Tests 451 passed (451).
- `DataPillar.*`, `StudioDesignSurface.grid*`: Test Files 42 passed (42), Tests 213 passed (213).
- Rail-reading suites (`railLabels`, `flowRegistration-12349`, `flowStatusTruth-11779`, `oneSurface-28572`, `railUnboundReason-11281`, `InterfacesPillar.offNav*`), `packages/i18n/`, the product-neutral ratchet: Test Files 112 passed (112), Tests 2109 passed, 13 skipped.
- Before the merge, at `6eaa56dc`: all of `views/studio-design/` plus `packages/i18n/`: Test Files 452 passed (452), Tests 4695 passed, 13 skipped.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` at 0be07d82: 39 families, each run with its exit code recorded, all 0; `--ran` reconciliation: 39 derived, 39 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new.

</details>

<details><summary>Item 1 in Chromium (the real StudioRail, server-rendered, its Tailwind classes compiled)</summary>

Host width / rail / content: 1280 with slot 420 → 860 / 52 / 808; 1280 with slot 360 → 920 / 52 / 868; 1280 slot closed → 1280 / 240 / 1040; 1440 with slot 420 → 1020 / 52 / 968; 1600 with slot 420 → 1180 / 240 / 940; 1024 slot closed → 240 rail. In the narrow form the heading, search, footer, group headers and non-row notes are not displayed and each row's generated content is its first character; floating, the panel is 240 px over the content with everything shown.

</details>

NOT MEASURED: the full console at 1280×800 against a running backend (all four items), reason: no dev stack was started in this container; the layout readings above are from the real rail markup and its compiled CSS, and the matrix and grid layouts from jsdom pins only.
